FLUQON.QPON / CONTRIBUTING

Bring the source.
Skip the noise.

A useful contribution helps someone understand the actual offer.

The source is open. Check contribute.fluq_ for current pilot availability. Submissions are reviewed before publication.

What belongs here

Australian offers with a retailer source, clear eligibility, exclusions and expiry. Explain who receives any referral reward or commission and what the shopper gets. Do not silently replace someone else’s referral link.

How edits work

  1. Sign in and choose a public name.
  2. Add an offer or load the latest revision to correct it.
  3. Describe the change and link the source.
  4. A reviewer independently checks it before publication.

Reading and copying codes still need no account. A contribution, vote or working link does not prove a code was accepted at checkout. Normal verification expires after 24 hours; glitches need an actual checkout check and expire after four.

Public history

Accepted edits retain a public name, dated change summary and source. Earlier revisions remain historical, even after prices change. Restoring an earlier version creates a new proposal and needs a fresh check. Maintainers can remove private or harmful material from public history.

Respect the people doing the work

No harassment, impersonation, spam or undisclosed paid placements. Explain disagreements with sources. New submissions and discussion notes await review. The owner can restrict access and protect pages.

Your material and privacy

Submit your own short factual wording. Link to retailer terms instead of copying their entire page. Never post personal details, payment information, emails, order numbers or private reports. When contributor sign-in is open, Supabase handles private authentication and Brevo delivers the codes you request. Signing in does not subscribe you to deal alerts.

Software uses AGPL-3.0-only. By submitting original offer text for inclusion, you license it under CC BY-SA 4.0, with your public name and change history retained. You keep ownership. Brand artwork, retailer material and private records are outside that content licence.

Help improve the software

The public source repository includes setup instructions, tests and contribution guidelines. Code changes use pull requests and maintainer review. Report security issues privately through the documented security contact; do not post credentials or customer data in public issues.
